license_required.quote: All persons subsequently desiring to commence the practice of podiatry in this state shall apply to the division of professional regulation for a license.

issuing_authority.value: Division of Professional Regulation, Rhode Island Department of Health
issuing_authority.quote: The director has the following duties and powers: To issue, pursuant to any rules and regulations promulgated by the board and approved by the director, all licenses and registrations required by this chapter to duly qualified applicants

name.value: Rhode Island Board of Examiners in Podiatry
name.quote: "Board" means the Rhode Island board of examiners in podiatry.

type.quote: "Board" means the Rhode Island board of examiners in podiatry.

umbrella_agency.quote: "Department" means the Rhode Island department of health.

age_minimum.quote: satisfactory proof that the applicant is more than eighteen (18) years of age

degree_required.quote: The applicant shall provide evidence that the degree doctor of podiatric medicine was conferred upon the applicant from the same college as was his or her course of study.

accrediting_body.value: Council on Podiatric Medical Education of the American Podiatric Medical Association
accrediting_body.quote: The applicant shall provide evidence of satisfactory completion of a course of study in podiatric medicine approved and accredited by the Council on Podiatric Medical Education of the American Podiatric Medical Association.

required.quote: the applicant shall provide evidence of satisfactory completion of a minimum one-year residency program as defined, recognized, and accredited by the Council on Podiatric Medical Education of the American Podiatric Medical Association

kind.quote: minimum one-year residency program as defined, recognized, and accredited by the Council on Podiatric Medical Education of the American Podiatric Medical Association

exams.name: Theoretical examination
exams.quote: All applicants are required to take an examination with respect to theory as well as a practical examination.

exams.name: Practical examination
exams.quote: no applicant is permitted to take the practical examination until he or she has satisfactorily passed the theoretical examination and has completed his or her residency

interval_years.quote: All licenses to practice podiatry shall be renewed biennially on the date of expiration.

required.quote: The application shall be accompanied or supported by evidence of the completion of a minimum of fifteen (15) continuing medical education credits per year as approved by the board of examiners in podiatry.

hours_per_period.quote: minimum of fifteen (15) continuing medical education credits per year

period_years.quote: fifteen (15) continuing medical education credits per year

available.quote: There shall be no reciprocity in granting licenses for the practice of podiatric medicine and surgery (podiatry) to licensees from other states or countries.

exists.quote: "Board" means the Rhode Island board of examiners in podiatry.

national_association.quote: Council on Podiatric Medical Education of the American Podiatric Medical Association

regulatory_model.quote: All persons subsequently desiring to commence the practice of podiatry in this state shall apply to the division of professional regulation for a license.

credential_type.quote: All persons subsequently desiring to commence the practice of podiatry in this state shall apply to the division of professional regulation for a license.

is_mandatory.quote: Any person except a licensed podiatrist, a licensed osteopathic physician, or a physician, licensed to practice medicine or surgery, who practices or attempts to practice podiatry...shall upon the first conviction be punished

title_protection.quote: No person granted a certificate under this chapter shall display or use the title "doctor" or its synonym without the designation "podiatrist" or "podiatric medicine and surgery"

scope_protection.quote: Any person except a licensed podiatrist, a licensed osteopathic physician, or a physician, licensed to practice medicine or surgery, who practices or attempts to practice podiatry...is guilty of a felony

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraudulent or deceptive procuring or use of a license or limited registration
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fraudulent or deceptive procuring or use of a license of limited registration

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertising that is intended or has a tendency to deceive the public
disciplinary_grounds.quote: All advertising of podiatry business that is intended or has a tendency to deceive the public

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a felony or crime arising out of the practice of podiatry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of a felony, or conviction of a crime arising out of the practice of podiatry

disciplinary_grounds.description: Abandonment of a patient
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Abandonment of a patient

disciplinary_grounds.description: Dependence upon controlled substance, habitual drunkenness, or rendering services while intoxicated or incapacitated
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Dependence upon a controlled substance, habitual drunkenness, or rendering professional services to a patient while the podiatrist or limited registrant is intoxicated or incapacitated by the use of drugs

disciplinary_grounds.description: Promotion of sale of drugs, devices, or services in a manner that exploits the patient for financial gain
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Promotion by a podiatrist or limited registrant of the sale of drugs, devices, appliances, or goods or services provided for a patient in a manner that exploits the patient for the financial gain of the podiatrist or limited registrant

disciplinary_grounds.description: Immoral conduct in the practice of podiatry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Immoral conduct of a podiatrist or limited registrant in the practice of podiatry

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully making and filing false reports or records
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willfully making and filing false reports or records in the practice of podiatry

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willful omission to file or record required reports or inducing another to omit filing
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willful omission to file or record, or willfully impeding or obstructing a filing or recording, or inducing another person to omit to file or record podiatry/medical or other reports as required by law

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to furnish patient medical records to succeeding podiatrist or facility upon request
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to furnish details of a patient's medical record to a succeeding podiatrist or medical facility upon proper request pursuant to this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Solicitation of professional patronage by agents or profiting from agent referrals
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Solicitation of professional patronage by agents or persons or profiting from acts of those representing themselves to be agents of the licensed podiatrist or limited registrant

disciplinary_grounds.description: Division of fees or agreeing to split fees for patient referrals
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Division of fees or agreeing to split or divide the fees received for professional services for any person for bringing to or referring a patient

disciplinary_grounds.description: Accepting payments from laboratories for tests or work referred
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Agreeing with clinical or bioanalytical laboratories to accept payments from those laboratories for individual tests or test series for patients, or agreeing with podiatry laboratories to accept payment from those laboratories for work referred

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willful misrepresentation in treatment
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willful misrepresentation in treatment

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing with unlicensed podiatrist or aiding unlicensed persons in practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practicing podiatry with an unlicensed podiatrist except in accordance with the rules and regulations of the board, or aiding or abetting those unlicensed persons in the practice of podiatry

disciplinary_grounds.description: Gross and willful overcharging for services or filing false statements for collection
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Gross and willful overcharging for professional services, including filing of false statements for collection of fees for which services are not rendered or willfully making or assisting in making a false claim or deceptive claim or misrepresenting a material fact for use in determining rights to podiatric care or other benefits

disciplinary_grounds.description: Offering to cure or treat disease by secret method or medicine
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Offering, undertaking, or agreeing to cure or treat disease by a secret method, procedure, treatment, or medicine

disciplinary_grounds.description: Professional or mental incompetence
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Professional or mental incompetence

disciplinary_grounds.description: Incompetent, negligent, or willful misconduct including unnecessary services and departure from minimal standards of acceptable practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Incompetent, negligent, or willful misconduct in the practice of podiatry that includes the rendering of unnecessary podiatry services and any departure from or the failure to conform to the minimal standards of acceptable and prevailing podiatry practice in his or her area of expertise as is determined by the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Revocation, suspension, or limitation of privilege in another state or disciplinary action against professional association membership
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Revocation, suspension, surrender, or limitation of privilege based on quality of care provided or any other disciplinary action against a license to practice podiatry in another state or jurisdiction, or revocation, suspension, surrender, or other disciplinary action as to membership on any podiatry staff or in any podiatry or professional association or society for conduct similar to acts or conduct that would constitute grounds for action as set forth in this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Adverse judgment, settlement, or award arising from medical liability claim
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any adverse judgment, settlement, or award arising from a medical liability claim related to acts or conduct similar to acts or conduct that would constitute grounds for action as defined in this chapter or regulations adopted pursuant to this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to furnish board with legally requested information
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to furnish the board, its director, investigator, or representative information legally requested by the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Cheating on or attempting to subvert the licensing examination
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Cheating on or attempting to subvert the licensing examination

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of state or federal law relating to controlled substances
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating any state or federal law or regulation relating to controlled substances

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to maintain standards established by peer-review boards
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to maintain standards established by peer-review boards, including but not limited to, standards related to proper utilization of services, and use of nonaccepted procedure or quality of care

disciplinary_grounds.description: Charging personal injury claimant more than insurer reimbursement as condition of treatment
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A podiatrist providing services to a person who is making a claim as a result of a personal injury, who charges or collects from the person any amount in excess of the reimbursement to the podiatrist by the insurer as a condition of providing or continuing to provide services or treatment

definition_quote.value: Any person is practicing podiatry within the meaning of this chapter who uses or permits to be used, directly or indirectly, for profit or otherwise, for their own self or for any other person, in connection with their own name, the word "podiatrist" or "podiatric physician and surgeon," or the title DPM, or any other words, letters, titles, or descriptive matter, personal or not, that directly or indirectly implies the practice of podiatry, or who owns, leases, maintains, or operates a podiatry business in any office or other room or rooms where podiatry operations are performed, or directly or indirectly is manager, proprietor, or conductor of the business; or who directly or indirectly informs the public in any language, orally, in writing, or by drawings, demonstrations, specimens, signs, or pictures that he or she can perform or will attempt to perform foot operations of any kind; or who undertakes, by any means or method, gratuitously or for a salary, fee, money, or other reward paid or granted directly or indirectly to himself or herself or to any other person, to diagnose or profess to diagnose, or to treat or profess to treat, or to prescribe for or profess to prescribe for any of the lesions, diseases, disorders, or deficiencies of the pedal extremity.
definition_quote.quote: Any person is practicing podiatry within the meaning of this chapter who uses or permits to be used, directly or indirectly, for profit or otherwise, for their own self or for any other person, in connection with their own name, the word "podiatrist" or "podiatric physician and surgeon," or the title DPM, or any other words, letters, titles, or descriptive matter, personal or not, that directly or indirectly implies the practice of podiatry, or who owns, leases, maintains, or operates a podiatry business in any office or other room or rooms where podiatry operations are performed, or directly or indirectly is manager, proprietor, or conductor of the business; or who directly or indirectly informs the public in any language, orally, in writing, or by drawings, demonstrations, specimens, signs, or pictures that he or she can perform or will attempt to perform foot operations of any kind; or who undertakes, by any means or method, gratuitously or for a salary, fee, money, or other reward paid or granted directly or indirectly to himself or herself or to any other person, to diagnose or profess to diagnose, or to treat or profess to treat, or to prescribe for or profess to prescribe for any of the lesions, diseases, disorders, or deficiencies of the pedal extremity.

methods_authorized.quote: to diagnose or profess to diagnose, or to treat or profess to treat, or to prescribe for or profess to prescribe for any of the lesions, diseases, disorders, or deficiencies of the pedal extremity

drug_authority.value: Podiatrists may prescribe for lesions, diseases, disorders, or deficiencies of the pedal extremity
drug_authority.quote: to prescribe for or profess to prescribe for any of the lesions, diseases, disorders, or deficiencies of the pedal extremity

hospital_privileges_nondiscrimination.quote: "Podiatrist," a person licensed as described in this chapter, shall be considered a physician and surgeon of the foot and ankle. For the purposes of reimbursement by and for subscriber benefits/participation agreements with health maintenance organizations, nonprofit medical-service corporations, for-profit medical service corporations, and third-party insurers, it is unlawful to discriminate against podiatrists.

corrective_footwear_exemption.quote: Nothing in this chapter is construed to prohibit the fitting, recommending, or sale of orthopedic shoes by retail dealers or manufacturers; provided, that they are not made or fabricated from plaster casts or models or by any other means for specific individual persons except upon the prescription of a podiatrist or physician.
